label: Stress
description: Magical strain, exam pressure, and hard nights. At 5 Stress you burn out.

full.text: Burnout: clear 3 Stress and take the Burnout condition until you address it in downtime.

label: Advancements
description: Year-end gains you have not spent yet. Each point buys one stat, spell, subject, or talent.

label: Year
description: Your school year. It rises when a school year ends; Year 7 is the last.

label: Faculty Favor
description: How the faculty see you. Spend it to ask for access or leniency; low favor brings scrutiny.

label: Peer Standing
description: How the student body see you. Low standing brings mockery and closed doors; high standing brings help.
